title: Engine Will Not Start
shortDescription: Engine cranks but does not fire.
fullDescription: Echo SRM/GT trimmers fail to start most often due to stale fuel, gummed carburetor, or missing spark.

fixSteps.title: Drain fuel
fixSteps.instruction: Empty old gas, add fresh 50:1 mix.

title: Engine Flooded
shortDescription: Excess fuel in cylinder prevents firing.
fullDescription: Repeated priming or starting attempts can flood the cylinder with raw fuel.

fixSteps.title: Run mode pulls
fixSteps.instruction: Move choke to RUN, hold throttle wide open, pull 5-10x.

title: Engine Bogs at Throttle
fullDescription: Engine idles but bogs/dies under load due to lean fuel mix or clogged spark arrestor.

fixSteps.title: Clean arrestor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove muffler screen, brush carbon off, reinstall.

title: Speed-Feed Head Won't Advance
fullDescription: Echo Speed-Feed 400 head fails to feed line when welded inside spool from heat or improper winding.

fixSteps.title: Reload spool
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cap, install fresh 0.095 line per arrow direction.

title: Excessive Vibration
fullDescription: Out-of-balance head, broken anti-vibration mounts, or worn shaft bushings produce harmful vibration.

fixSteps.title: Trim line equal
fixSteps.instruction: Cut both line ends to equal length.

title: Fuel Line or Primer Leak
shortDescription: Fuel weeping from primer or lines.
fullDescription: Echo fuel and primer lines stiffen and crack with age, especially from ethanol exposure.

fixSteps.title: Replace lines
fixSteps.instruction: Install Echo OEM line kit; route through tank grommet.

faq.a: Yes do not run with leak.

title: Clutch Engages at Idle
fullDescription: Worn clutch shoes, broken springs, or idle set too high cause head to spin at idle - safety hazard.

fixSteps.title: Lower idle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn idle screw counterclockwise until head stops.

videoSearchQuery: Echo trimmer head spin idle fix

title: Engine Stalls After Warming
fullDescription: Vapor lock or vented cap fault prevents fuel flow once engine warms.

fixSteps.title: Loosen cap
fixSteps.instruction: Run with cap loose; if it works, replace tank vent.

title: Pull Cord Won't Rewind
shortDescription: Starter rope hangs out, won't retract.
fullDescription: Recoil spring slipped or broke; cord cannot be pulled or stays out.

fixSteps.title: Replace recoil
fixSteps.instruction: Remove starter cover, install new spring + cord assembly.

title: Ignition Has No Spark
fullDescription: Bad coil, fouled plug, or wrong air gap eliminates spark. Check plug first.

fixSteps.title: Test plug
fixSteps.instruction: Ground plug body to engine, pull rope, check for blue spark.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil
fixSteps.instruction: Set air gap to 0.012 in if installing new coil.

title: AFS bumper feed
fullDescription: AFS bumper-feed mechanism stuck. Common issue on Echo Tools string trimmer. Resolve following manufacturer service procedure.

fixSteps.title: Check fuel
fixSteps.instruction: Drain old fuel, refill with fresh.

fixSteps.title: Inspect spark plug
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and inspect spark plug; replace if fouled.

whenToCallPro: Engine internal issues require trained technician.

faq.a: Often yes — old gas causes carburetor varnish.
